abstract: While the treatment of ovarian cancer has made remarkable progress in recent years, the chemotherapy of ovarian germ cell tumor has not as yet been fully established and remains to be improved. We investigated the effectiveness of a single-agent therapy with Vincristine (VCR), Actinomycin D (ACD), and Cyclophosphamide (CPM) against a human undifferentiated dysgerminoma's cell line (JOHYL-1) with the following results. The ratio of the number of viable cells to the total cell population treated for JOHYL-1 cells of ascitic type was 70% with VCR, 58% with CPM and 25% with ACD; hence the efficacy on this malignant cell line was the greatest with ACD followed by VCR and CPM in that descending order. Notably with CPM, a striking antitumor effect was observed from 48 to 24 hours after treatment. The L.I. attained a peak at 24, 18 and 30 hours, respectively, after treatment with VCR, ACD and CPM. The M.I. was as high as a little more than 6% at 36 hours after treatment with VCR. There also was noted a shift in the cell cycle with any of the test drugs. Morphological changes observed in the cell were most obvious with ACD followed in order by VCR and CPM. LDH & isozyme pattern: In these respects there were no striking differences among the three drugs, even though the total enzyme activity was somewhat higher with VCR.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 近年、卵巣癌の治療は著しい進歩を遂げているが、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法はいまだ十分に確立されておらず、改善の余地がある。本研究では、ヒト未分化ディスジャーミノーマ細胞株(JOHYL-1)の腹水型細胞に対し、ビンクリスチン(VCR)、アクチノマイシンD(ACD)、シクロホスファミド(CPM)の単剤療法の有効性を検討した。治療後の全細胞数に対する生細胞数の割合は、VCRで70%、CPMで58%、ACDで25%であった。したがって、この悪性細胞株に対する効果は、ACDが最も大きく、次いでVCR、CPMの順であった。特にCPMでは、治療後48〜24時間の時点で顕著な抗腫瘍効果が認められた。標識率(L.I.)は、VCR、ACD、CPMの治療後それぞれ24、18、30時間でピークに達した。有糸分裂指数(M.I.)は、VCR治療後36時間で6%をわずかに超えて高値を示した。いずれの被験薬でも細胞周期のシフトが認められた。細胞の形態学的変化は、ACDで最も顕著であり、次いでVCR、CPMの順であった。LDHおよびアイソザイムパターンについては、3剤間に顕著な差はなかったが、総酵素活性はVCRでやや高かった。（抄録は250語で打ち切られています）
